changelog: Purged all Thai Unicode characters (0 Thai characters remaining): corrected all instances of Thai characters in Arithmetic Means (មធ្យมนព្វន្ត -> មធ្យមនព្វន្ត with Khmer ម ម and ន ន) and Thai word dai (ได้ -> បាន) across question_bank.json, point_quizzes.json, and standard_exams.json; implemented frontend automated sanitizer sanitizeKhmerText() in app.js and question-bank.js as a permanent safeguard against future accidental Thai character injections.
